value.rationale: Determines the entire idempotent-element set over every field of characteristic two for an infinite natural algebraic graph family, with a sharp quadratic-subfield jump. Separately determines exact two-step squaring dynamics and demonstrates why graph connectivity and expansion alone cannot govern algebraic persistence when coefficients cancel. Gives explicit unbounded hypercube and complete-graph families with contrasting ranks; not a routine reparameterization or arbitrary finite table.
